name: InvoiceMonthPicker
title: בורר חשבוניות לפי חודש
description: Use when the bookkeeper mentions a payment, payment promise, or claimed payment for a customer and it is unclear which invoices it covers. It loads that customer's open invoices itself (from the Invoices table: invoices with status פתוחה or שולמה חלקית that still have an open amount, credit notes excluded), groups them by due month (Hebrew month and year) with a select-all checkbox per month, and shows each invoice's number, due date, open amount and sub-status, plus a running selected total. When the bookkeeper clicks 'בחרתי', a user message comes back into the chat in this exact form: 'בחרתי את החשבוניות: 50231, 50240 (סה״כ 12,400 ₪)'. Read the invoice numbers from that message and continue (e.g. record the promise on those invoices). Props: customerCode (required, the Priority customer code of the customer in the card); preselectedInvoiceNumbers (optional, invoice numbers you already think the payment covers, e.g. ones whose open amounts add up to the mentioned sum; they start checked); prompt (optional, one Hebrew question line shown at the top, e.g. 'על אילו חשבוניות ההבטחה של 6,000 ₪?'). Do not pass invoice data; the component reads it. If the customer has no open invoices it says so and you should not wait for a selection.
